text:
meg_sales: FYI MerchantX surfaced a couple of blockers before we can close — asking for a rotation-window exception (they can only do key rotations 10:00-14:00 UTC due to maintenance calendar) and they want a contractual p95 latency SLA of 200ms for inference requests that reference their BYO-CMK via our HSM proxy. Also asking for a short POC next week to validate failover + perf.

lisa_security: rotation-window exception is possible but we need: rotation playbook, attestation logs, and assurance that rotation trigger + key versioning will be recorded in audit logs. also need to know who holds escrow and retention policy. :lock:

raj_eng: 200ms p95 over BYO-HSM proxy is optimistic. if requests hit a remote customer KMS over WAN it will add latency. to meet 200ms we should either: route MerchantX traffic to a Dedicated pool colocated in the same AZ as their KMS proxy, or use a local HSM proxy within our VPC with mutual TLS and short TTL caching for KEK unwrap.

natalie_sre: For the POC we can run synthetic load and p95 measurement. we'll need MerchantX IP ranges + cert fingerprint for allowlist. also want to test a failure mode (KMS unreachable) and validate fallback to cached KEK for X minutes. propose testing window: 2h warmup + 1h steady at target qps + 30m failover test.

ben_billing: Pricing notes: Dedicated capacity + BYO-HSM adds a platform surcharge + per-hour reserved GPU commit. for POC we can offer a temporary demo rate (10% of committed) and waive setup for a 2-week test. production quote will include: reserved pool base fee, HSM-proxy egress per-transaction, and optional extended logging retention. I can draft a SOW line item for this.

sam_platform: Let's capture acceptance criteria so sales + legal have something concrete. proposed ACs: 1) end-to-end gen with BYO-CMK unwrap <200ms p95 under normal load, 2) documented rotation playbook and successful test rotation during POC, 3) observed failover to cached KEK without request loss for 5m during KMS outage, 4) audit log visibility for all key ops.

meg_sales: @lisa_security @raj_eng can you confirm what attestation artifacts we need from MerchantX for the exception? They said they can provide HSM attest certs and a runbook but want to avoid key escrow if possible.

lisa_security: Attestation we need: HSM manufacturer cert chain, firmware image hash, key wrapping algorithm, and a signed statement of custodians. if they won't escrow, we require a stronger SLA and more frequent rotation proofs. also we need to add this as an exception appendix in contract.

raj_eng: Technically we can avoid escrow by increasing cache TTL and enforcing multi-region replication for the KEK cache, but that raises risk and cost. if they decline escrow, recommend: Dedicated pool + 1s KV cache + 3x redundancy across hosts. Also we should limit long-running streams that require repeated unwraps.

natalie_sre: POC checklist items I need from MerchantX: IP CIDRs, client cert PEM, expected QPS, typical prompt length (tokens), and a sample prompt set to simulate. Can they provide a 1-hour trace?

ben_billing: I'll include an estimated delta row in the quote: "BYO-CMK handling + HSM proxy egress" with per-million-call tiered pricing. rough placeholder: $2k/mo + $0.05 per 1k HSM ops. will firm after infra plan.

meg_sales: MerchantX prefers 10:00-14:00 UTC rotation window. If we lock that in, they want a 6mo pilot with an option to scale to reserved capacity. They're pushing for contract language that prevents us from forcing nightly rotations.

sam_platform: Legal will need explicit exception language and controls. I'll draft a minimal clause: allowed rotation window documented + we retain right to emergency rotation when key compromise detected. also add requirement for post-rotation verification within 24h.

lisa_security: one more: require retention of rotation audit logs for at least 1 year for their compliance bucket.

meg_sales: Great. Next steps: 1) Raj/Natalie confirm feasibility for 200ms p95 w/ dedicated pool and caching strategy by EOD tomorrow, 2) Lisa to list exact attestation doc set by EOD, 3) Ben to add placeholder SOW lines and POC pricing, 4) I'll coordinate MerchantX availability for POC next Thu-Fri.

raj_eng: Will run a quick sim today and post numbers. initial gut: dedicated + AZ-local proxy + TTL=1s caching could hit ~180-220ms p95 depending on payload. will follow up with microbench.

deploy-bot: POC-reservation created: res-POC-1766001234, window tentative 2026-04-09 to 2026-04-10. :calendar:

meg_sales: thanks all — tagging @ben_billing and @lisa_security for the SOW + contract appendix. I'll sync with MerchantX and share their infra docs when available. :thumbsup:
